5846.title: Logged background children omit Windows console suppression
5846.rootCauseOneLine: The managed-child spawn omits windowsHide; WMI relaunch requests only a hidden show state. The Windows-visible effect remains unverified.
5846.proposedFix: Validate actual console visibility on Windows first, then test explicit hidden-console launch at the logged-child boundary and separately evaluate WMI creation behavior.
5846.caveats: Two clean Linux checkouts confirmed the launch-option omission using real children, log capture, and IPC. No Windows desktop or console screenshot was available; WMI flag acceptance and user-visible behavior are unverified. Probe and exact output are embedded in the HTML; raw artifacts remain local. No fix PR was safe under the full-reproduction gate.
